name: Sanity
overview: Scripture presents sanity as a state of being in right relationship with God, characterized by uprightness and sincerity as seen in God's command to Abram to 'walk before me, and be thou perfect' (Genesis 17:1). True sanity involves loving the Lord with all one's heart, soul, and might (Deuteronomy 6:5), recognizing that we are wonderfully made by God (Psalms 139:14). The restoration of the man possessed by demons, who was found 'in his right mind' at Jesus' feet (Luke 8:35), illustrates that spiritual sanity is found through Christ, who is the source of life and salvation (John 3:16).
